intro: Lost Necklace is an introductory task in southern Elwynn Forest given by "Auntie" Bernice Stonefield. Suspecting theft by the rival clan's mischievous young boy, Bernice sends adventurers across the road to confront Billy Maclure and retrieve her missing heirloom.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I lost my necklace, and think that guttersnipe Billy Maclure took it! He's usually scuttling like a rat around the Maclure Vineyards east of here.
Get my necklace back for me, and you'll warm an old widow's heart.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You lost a what? Well I didn't take no necklace, because I ain't no thief!
I might know who did but......I'm too hungry to remember.
